app: LibreOffice Writer — object-model WRITE path (mirror of macOS Pages read+write)
channel_setup: pyuno: loadComponentFromURL(private:factory/swriter, Hidden) then insertString at text end; read back getString().

t1_read_text.detail: Round-trip exact including accents AND emoji: 'INSERE-PAR-UNO éàü 😀 12345' written then read back identical.

t3_live_value.detail: Writes 9.4-109 ms, read 0.9 ms — same class as macOS Pages (73-158 ms). Actuation through the model needs no coordinates at all.

t5_blind_action.detail: Semantic actuation (insertString) verified in-channel — the strongest form of blind action.

measurements.notes: Ops note mirroring macOS session-lock lesson: after many soffice restarts the default port 2002 stopped binding (env wedging, like Chromium DevTools earlier); port 2003 fine. Router lesson: treat socket bring-up as retry-with-fresh-port, not fixed endpoint.
